// taken from https://github.com/Adamsdown-Boy/destiny-rolls/blob/main/player-versus-enemies-rolls/ep177-the-best-trace-rifles.txt

title:PvE Podcast 177 - The Best Trace Rifles
description:Monument of Triumph new and reprised Trace Rifles, based on trait perk discussions between @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways in the 4 August 2026 @PodvsEnemies podcast (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4AemBHDclMhu14RT88A1rG). Destiny Data Compendium, Aegis's Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​ and other resources, available at https://www.destiny2.science/, or through https://www.youtube.com/@TheAegisRelic. The effect of weapon perks on stats can be found at https://destiny.report or https://d2foundry.gg 

// Action Item - PvE Minor god 1
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Tactical Battery, Light Battery, Enhanced Battery), (Rimestealer, Demolitionist, Rewind Rounds), (Crystalline Corpsebloom, Headstone)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Stasis builds. Action Item is an adaptive trace rifle, which are rated A-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "high utility for shot count-sensitive use cases, Harsh Refraction makes damage profile competitive". It's available from Iron Banner if you fancy a bit of PvP. The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The Recoil Direction is pretty much perfect, so you can look for your preference of Handling, Stability or Range with the barrel perk. For the battery perk, Tactical or Light Battery boost gunfeel stats or Enhanced Battery adds a few extra shots. For Stasis synergy, in the first trait perk column, Rimestealer generates ×2 stacks of Stasis Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy. There's also perks to help delay the need to reload - Demolitionist generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills and an instant battery refill on grenade use, or Rewind Rounds refills 70% of hits landed from reserves when the battery empties, effectively increasing battery size by around ×3.0-3.3 if you hit all your shots and delaying the need to reload. In the second column, Crystalline Corpsebloom procs on a kill to provide a 4s buff - kills with the buff active generate a Stasis seeker which travels 3m before spawning a large Stasis crystal or Headstone generates a Stasis crystal on a crit kill. These crystals are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc weapon traits and subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. Aegis ranks the Nail, Meet Hammer origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - it grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Heavy Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. There also the D-Tier Omolon Fluid Dynamics which boosts Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by +30 when the battery's full, decreasing linearly until the mag's at 50%. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.|tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller

// Action Item - PvE Minor god 2
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Tactical Battery, Light Battery, Enhanced Battery), (Demolitionist, Rewind Rounds), (Killing Tally, Elemental Honing)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Action Item is an adaptive trace rifle, which are rated A-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "high utility for shot count-sensitive use cases, Harsh Refraction makes damage profile competitive". It's available from Iron Banner if you fancy a bit of PvP. The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The Recoil Direction is pretty much perfect, so you can look for your preference of Handling, Stability or Range with the barrel perk. For the battery perk, Tactical or Light Battery boost gunfeel stats or Enhanced Battery adds a few extra shots. In the first trait perk column to delay the need to reload, Demolitionist generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills and an instant battery refill on grenade use, or Rewind Rounds refills 70% of hits landed from reserves when the battery empties, effectively increasing battery size by around ×3.0-3.3 if you hit all your shots and delaying the need to reload. In the second column for damage, Killing Tally gains a stack for each enemy killed up to ×3 to boost damage by up to ×1.3 until you reload or stow or, if you're using a Prismatic build, Elemental Honing grants an escalating stack of damage up to max ×1.35 for 23s for each elemental damage type inflicted, which can be refreshed with a new damage type until you've run through all 5. Aegis ranks the Nail, Meet Hammer origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - it grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Heavy Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. There also the D-Tier Omolon Fluid Dynamics which boosts Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by +30 when the battery's full, decreasing linearly until the mag's at 50%. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.|tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Action Item - PvE Minor god 3
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Tactical Battery, Light Battery, Enhanced Battery), (Demolitionist, Rewind Rounds), (Detonator Beam)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Action Item is an adaptive trace rifle, which are rated A-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "high utility for shot count-sensitive use cases, Harsh Refraction makes damage profile competitive". It's available from Iron Banner if you fancy a bit of PvP. The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The Recoil Direction is pretty much perfect, so you can look for your preference of Handling, Stability or Range with the barrel perk. For the battery perk, Tactical or Light Battery boost gunfeel stats or Enhanced Battery adds a few extra shots. In the first trait perk column to delay the need to reload, Demolitionist generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills and an instant battery refill on grenade use, or Rewind Rounds refills 70% of hits landed from reserves when the battery empties, effectively increasing battery size by around ×3.0-3.3 if you hit all your shots and delaying the need to reload. In the second column for area damage, Detonator Beam procs an 8m AoE Stasis explosion after 20 hits - this counts as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. Aegis ranks the Nail, Meet Hammer origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - it grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Heavy Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. There also the D-Tier Omolon Fluid Dynamics which boosts Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by +30 when the battery's full, decreasing linearly until the mag's at 50%. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.|tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// 21% Delirium - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Eddy Current, Light Touch, Trickle Charge), (Gear Shift)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly on Arc builds. 21% Delirium is a rapid fire LMG, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "good damage profile but mediocre total damage and worst recoil of any LMG frame". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right and loose so you should improve recoil control or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, any of the combat effect mags, or perks that improve Reload Speed or mag size are fine. For dealing with tougher adds with an Arc build to proc Amplified, in the first trait perk column Eddy Current boosts Handling with a ×0.95 animation scalar and +20 Reload Speed with a ×0.95 animation scalar for 3s after sprinting for 1.5s, which is all applied instantly with +60 to Reload Speed when Amplified, Light Touch boosts Handling and Reload Speed, and provides an ADS scalar while you're Amplified, or if you're using a Storm's Keep rally barricade, Trickle Charge refills 10% of the magazine on receiving a stack of Arc Bolt Charge, and 20% when you discharge with a lightning bolt on a target. In the second column for damage, Gear Shift stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost. Aegis ranks the Gun and Run origin trait as D-Tier - it grants up to ×3 stacks on kills for 11s, which after sprinting for 0.75s consumes stacks to reload 25% of your magazine every 0.85s, refreshing the buff duration. If you're interested, the name is a play on atmospheric chemistry - Earth's atmosphere is ~21% oxygen - and the chaotic state of mind caused by intense combat. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.|tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// 21% Delirium - PvE Boss god AB 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Fourth Time's the Charm, Trickle Charge, Overflow, Reconstruction), (Jolting Feedback, Rolling Storm, Killing Tally)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamege PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for sustained DPS against a single yellow-bar target in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly on Arc builds. 21% Delirium is a rapid fire LMG, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "good damage profile but mediocre total damage and worst recoil of any LMG frame". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right and loose so you should improve recoil control or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, perks that improve Reload Speed or mag size work best for a boss damage roll. For sustained boss damage with an Arc build, in the first trait perk column Fourth Time's the Charm generates 2 shots from thin air after 4 crits within 3s of each other, almost doubling your total ammo if you can keep hitting crits, or if you're using a Storm's Keep rally barricade, Trickle Charge refills 10% of the magazine on receiving a stack of Arc Bolt Charge, and 20% when you discharge with a lightning bolt on a target. Alternatively, Overflow refills the magazine and boosts its capacity to ×2.2 of base, rounded up, on picking up an ammo brick or Reconstruction refills 25% of the magazine every 5.5s up to ×2 capacity when stowed or not firing. In the second column for both target and AoE damage, Jolting Feedback applies Arc Jolt after 14 hits (11 when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits, or Rolling Storm generates ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks. Alternatively, if you can get kills during an add phase, Killing Tally gains a stack for each enemy killed up to ×3 to boost damage by up to ×1.3 until you reload or stow. Aegis ranks the Gun and Run origin trait as D-Tier - it grants up to ×3 stacks on kills for 11s, which after sprinting for 0.75s consumes stacks to reload 25% of your magazine every 0.85s, refreshing the buff duration. If you're interested, the name is a play on atmospheric chemistry - Earth's atmosphere is ~21% oxygen - and the chaotic state of mind caused by intense combat. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.|tags:PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamege PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// 21% Delirium - PvE Minor god AB 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Trickle Charge, Light Touch, Eddy Current), (One for All)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly on Arc builds. 21% Delirium is a rapid fire LMG, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "good damage profile but mediocre total damage and worst recoil of any LMG frame". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right and loose so you should improve recoil control or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, any of the combat effect mags, or perks that improve Reload Speed or mag size are fine. For dealing with tougher adds with an Arc build, in the first trait perk column if you're using a Storm's Keep rally barricade, Trickle Charge refills 10% of the magazine on receiving a stack of Arc Bolt Charge, and 20% when you discharge with a lightning bolt on a target, or Light Touch boosts Handling and Reload Speed, and provides an ADS scalar while you're Amplified. Alternatively, Eddy Current boosts Handling with a ×0.95 animation scalar and +20 Reload Speed with a ×0.95 animation scalar for 3s after sprinting for 1.5s, which is all applied instantly with +60 to Reload Speed when Amplified. For damage, in the second column One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for a non-refreshable 10s (11s when enhanced) after hitting three separate targets within 3s of each. Aegis ranks the Gun and Run origin trait as D-Tier - it grants up to ×3 stacks on kills for 11s, which after sprinting for 0.75s consumes stacks to reload 25% of your magazine every 0.85s, refreshing the buff duration. If you're interested, the name is a play on atmospheric chemistry - Earth's atmosphere is ~21% oxygen - and the chaotic state of mind caused by intense combat. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.|tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// 21% Delirium - PvE Minor god AB 2
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Fourth Time's the Charm, Overflow, Reconstruction, Feeding Frenzy), (One for All)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. 21% Delirium is a rapid fire LMG, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "good damage profile but mediocre total damage and worst recoil of any LMG frame". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right and loose so you should improve recoil control or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, any of the combat effect mags, or perks that improve Reload Speed or mag size are fine. For dealing with tougher adds, in the first trait perk column Fourth Time's the Charm generates 2 shots from thin air after 4 crits within 3s of each other, almost doubling your total ammo if you can keep hitting crits, Overflow refills the magazine and boosts its capacity to ×2.2 of base, rounded up, on picking up an ammo brick or Reconstruction refills 25% of the magazine every 5.5s up to ×2 capacity when stowed or not firing. Alternatively, Feeding Frenzy kills provide up to 5 stacks for +100 Reload Speed with a ×0.8 animation scalar for 3.5s. For damage, in the second column One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for a non-refreshable 11s after hitting three separate targets within 3s of each. Aegis ranks the Gun and Run origin trait as D-Tier - it grants up to ×3 stacks on kills for 11s, which after sprinting for 0.75s consumes stacks to reload 25% of your magazine every 0.85s, refreshing the buff duration. If you're interested, the name is a play on atmospheric chemistry - Earth's atmosphere is ~21% oxygen - and the chaotic state of mind caused by intense combat. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.|tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// 21% Delirium - PvE Minor god AB 3
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Feeding Frenzy), (Mega Kill Clip)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. 21% Delirium is a rapid fire LMG, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "good damage profile but mediocre total damage and worst recoil of any LMG frame". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right and loose so you should improve recoil control or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, any of the combat effect mags, or perks that improve Reload Speed or mag size are fine. For dealing with tougher adds, in the first trait perk column if you're running an Arc build, Light Touch boosts Handling and Reload Speed, and provides an ADS scalar while you're Amplified, or Eddy Current boosts Handling with a ×0.95 animation scalar and +20 Reload Speed with a ×0.95 animation scalar for 3s after sprinting for 1.5s, which is all applied instantly with +60 to Reload Speed when Amplified. If not, then Feeding Frenzy kills provide up to 5 stacks for +100 Reload Speed with a ×0.8 animation scalar for 3.5s. For damage, in the second column Mega Kill Clip boosts damage by ×1.4 with a duration of 3s + (2s × the number of kills) up to a max 20s, on a reload within 5s of a kill. Aegis ranks the Gun and Run origin trait as D-Tier - it grants up to ×3 stacks on kills for 11s, which after sprinting for 0.75s consumes stacks to reload 25% of your magazine every 0.85s, refreshing the buff duration. If you're interested, the name is a play on atmospheric chemistry - Earth's atmosphere is ~21% oxygen - and the chaotic state of mind caused by intense combat. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.|tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Action Item - PvE Boss god 1
// (Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling), (Enhanced Battery, ionized Battery, Tactical Battery, Light Battery), (Rewind Rounds, High-Impact Reserves), (Target Lock)
//notes:Adamsdown_Boy written as at v9.5.6.2 (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for a backup special that provides sustained boss damage, when you're out of heavy ammo, in activities rated Normal, Hard and Very Hard difficulty. Action Item is an adaptive trace rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being useful for shooting objectives and keeping special, with a decent add clear score as well. The frame intrinsic offers no bonuses beyond "being well-rounded and reliable" as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. By comparison with its peers, the stats are decent - you can see at https://d2foundry.gg/w/437854391 how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Stability is a bit low, so to help keep hitting crits, use the barrel perk to help out or, if you're able to control the beam, spec into Handling. Use the battery perk to boost the battery capacity or reload. For sustained fire against a boss, in the first trait perk column, the obvious choice is Rewind Rounds which refills 60% of hits landed (70% when enhanced) from reserves when the magazine empties, but there's also the double damage perk possibility of High Impact Reserves which boosts damage from ×1.121 to ×1.256 as the battery drops below 50% (55% enhanced) with Target Lock in the second column, that stacks up to 5 times on repeated hits within 0.2s of each other for up to ×1.4 damage at 110.33% of base magazine capacity. There's the choice of two origin traits - Nail, Meet Hammer grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Heavy Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. Alternatively, Omolon Fluid Dynamics boosts Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by up to +30 in the top half of the battery, decreasing linearly until it's at 50%. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.|tags:PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

//notes: // (Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling), (Enhanced Battery, Tactical Battery, Light Battery), (Rimestealer), (Crystalline Corpsebloom, Headstone)
//notes:Adamsdown_Boy written as at v9.5.6.2 (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds, in activities rated Normal difficulty, especially on Stasis builds. Action Item is an adaptive trace rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being useful for shooting objectives and keeping special, with a decent add clear score as well. The frame intrinsic offers no bonuses beyond "being well-rounded and reliable" as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. By comparison with its peers, the stats are decent - you can see at https://d2foundry.gg/w/437854391 how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Stability is a bit low, so to help keep hitting crits, use the barrel perk to help out or, if you're able to control the beam, spec into Handling. Use the battery perk to boost the battery capacity or reload. For Stasis synergy, there's the trait perk combination of Rimestealer which generates a stack (2 stacks when enhanced) of Stasis Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy and Crystalline Corpsebloom that procs on a kill to provide a 4s buff - kills with the buff active generate a Stasis seeker which travels 3m before spawning a medium Stasis crystal (large when enhanced), or Headstone which generates a Stasis crystal on a crit kill. The crystals are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc weapon traits and subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. There's the choice of two origin traits - Nail, Meet Hammer grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Heavy Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. Alternatively, Omolon Fluid Dynamics boosts Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by up to +30 in the top half of the battery, decreasing linearly until it's at 50%. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.|tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Action Item - PvE Minor god 2
//notes: // (Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling), (Enhanced Battery, Tactical Battery, Light Battery), (Demolitionist, Rewind Rounds, Envious Assassin), (Killing Tally)
//notes:Adamsdown_Boy written as at v9.5.6.2 (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies, in activities rated Normal, Hard and Very Hard difficulty, especially on Stasis builds. Action Item is an adaptive trace rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being useful for shooting objectives and keeping special, with a decent add clear score as well. The frame intrinsic offers no bonuses beyond "being well-rounded and reliable" as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. By comparison with its peers, the stats are decent - you can see at https://d2foundry.gg/w/437854391 how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Stability is a bit low, so to help keep hitting crits, use the barrel perk to help out or, if you're able to control the beam, spec into Handling. Use the battery perk to boost the battery capacity or reload. For tackling tougher Minor, and Elite adds, in the first trait perk column you can use Demolitionist to generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills to use for an instant battery refill on grenade use, or Rewind Rounds to refill 60% of hits landed (70% when enhanced) from reserves when the magazine empties, or finally Envious Assassin to overflow the battery to up to ×3 capacity at 10% of mag size per kill with primary weapons and 20% with heavy (12.5%/22.5% enhanced) before readying. Then, in the second, you can use your increased battery capacity to maintain uptime on Killing Tally, which gains a stack for each enemy killed up to ×3 to boost damage by up to ×1.3 until you reload or stow. There's the choice of two origin traits - Nail, Meet Hammer grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Heavy Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. Alternatively, Omolon Fluid Dynamics boosts Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by up to +30 in the top half of the battery, decreasing linearly until it's at 50%. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.|tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Action Item - PvE Minor god 3
//notes: // (Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling), (Enhanced Battery, Tactical Battery, Light Battery), (Demolitionist, Rewind Rounds, Envious Assassin), (Detonator Beam)
//notes:Adamsdown_Boy written as at v9.5.6.2 (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies, in activities rated Normal, Hard and Very Hard difficulty, especially on Stasis builds. Action Item is an adaptive trace rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being useful for shooting objectives and keeping special, with a decent add clear score as well. The frame intrinsic offers no bonuses beyond "being well-rounded and reliable" as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. By comparison with its peers, the stats are decent - you can see at https://d2foundry.gg/w/437854391 how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Stability is a bit low, so to help keep hitting crits, use the barrel perk to help out or, if you're able to control the beam, spec into Handling. Use the battery perk to boost the battery capacity or reload. For tackling groups of adds, in the first trait perk column you can use Demolitionist to generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills to use for an instant battery refill on grenade use, or Rewind Rounds to refill 60% of hits landed (70% when enhanced) from reserves when the magazine empties, or finally Envious Assassin to overflow the battery to up to ×3 capacity at 10% of mag size per kill with primary weapons and 20% with heavy (12.5%/22.5% enhanced) before readying. Then, in the second, you can use your increased battery capacity to repeatedly proc Detonator Beam's 8m AoE Stasis explosion after 25 hits (20 enhanced). There's the choice of two origin traits - Nail, Meet Hammer grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Heavy Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. Alternatively, Omolon Fluid Dynamics boosts Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by up to +30 in the top half of the battery, decreasing linearly until it's at 50%. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.|tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller
